name: AI Commerce V4.2 - 01C Operations Spreadsheet Init

parameters.query:
SELECT ba.*,b.business_name,
 (SELECT value FROM system_settings WHERE key='control_spreadsheet_id') AS control_spreadsheet_id,
 (SELECT value FROM system_settings WHERE key=('ops_sheet_bound:'||ba.id::text)) AS last_bound_spreadsheet_id
FROM business_accounts ba
JOIN businesses b ON b.business_id=ba.business_id
WHERE ba.active=TRUE AND b.active=TRUE
ORDER BY ba.id;

nodes.name: 04.01 - Load Active Accounts for Spreadsheet Init

parameters.jsCode: const a=$('04.01 - Load Active Accounts for Spreadsheet Init').item.json;return[{json:{...a,operations_spreadsheet_id:$json.spreadsheetId}}];

parameters.query: UPDATE business_accounts SET operations_spreadsheet_id=$1,updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$2::bigint RETURNING $3::jsonb AS ctx;

nodes.name: 04.07 - Write New Spreadsheet ID Back to Control

parameters.query:
SELECT $4::jsonb AS ctx,
 (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM products WHERE account_id=$1::bigint) AS product_count,
 (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM knowledge_base WHERE account_id=$1::bigint) AS faq_count,
 (SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM orders WHERE account_id=$1::bigint) AS order_count,
 ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE account_id=$1::bigint)+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_base WHERE account_id=$1::bigint)+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE account_id=$1::bigint)>0) AS db_has_data,
 (COALESCE($2::text,'')<>COALESCE($3::text,'') OR $5::boolean) AS needs_reconcile;

SELECT $2::jsonb AS ctx,
COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'externalProductId',p.external_product_id,'productGroupId',COALESCE(p.product_group_id,''),'variantId',COALESCE(p.variant_id,''),'sku',COALESCE(p.sku,''),
 'name',p.name,'variantName',COALESCE(p.variant_name,''),'category',COALESCE(p.category,''),'subcategory',COALESCE(p.subcategory,''),
 'price',p.price,'currency',p.currency,'stockQty',p.stock_qty,'stockStatus',COALESCE(p.stock_status,''),'color',COALESCE(p.color,''),'size',COALESCE(p.size,''),
 'description',COALESCE(p.description,''),'summary',COALESCE(p.ai_summary,''),'productUrl',COALESCE(p.product_url,''),'imageUrl',COALESCE(p.image_url,''),
 'offer',COALESCE(p.offer,''),'discount',COALESCE(p.discount,''),'aliases',COALESCE(p.aliases,''),'active',p.active,'updatedAt',p.updated_at,
 'media',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(pm.resolved_url ORDER BY pm.sort_order) FROM product_media pm WHERE pm.product_id=p.id AND pm.active=TRUE AND COALESCE(pm.resolved_url,'')<>''),'[]'::jsonb)
) ORDER BY p.id) FROM products p WHERE p.account_id=$1::bigint),'[]'::jsonb) AS products,
COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key',k.external_key,'question',COALESCE(k.question,''),'answer',k.answer,'category',COALESCE(k.category,''),'active',k.active,'updatedAt',k.updated_at) ORDER BY k.id) FROM knowledge_base k WHERE k.account_id=$1::bigint),'[]'::jsonb) AS faqs,
COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
 'orderNumber',o.order_number,'createdAt',o.created_at,'status',o.status,'customerName',COALESCE(o.customer_name,''),'phone',COALESCE(o.phone,''),'address',COALESCE(o.address,''),
 'product',COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(oi.product_name,', ' ORDER BY oi.id) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id=o.id),''),
 'quantity',COALESCE((SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id=o.id),0),
 'unitPrice',COALESCE((SELECT MAX(oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.order_id=o.id),0),
 'deliveryCharge',o.delivery_charge,'grandTotal',o.total,'paymentMethod',COALESCE(o.payment_method,''),'notes',COALESCE(o.note,''),'conversationId',''
) ORDER BY o.created_at,o.id) FROM orders o WHERE o.account_id=$1::bigint),'[]'::jsonb) AS orders;
